This Class is only used by the AUTOSAR Classic Platform. Base ARObject, Identifiable, MultilanguageReferrable, Referrable Aggregated by SystemMapping.ecuPartitionT oCoreMapping Attribute Type Mult. Kind Note coreId PositiveInteger 0..1 attr Optional definition of Core Id. ecuPartition EcuPartition 0..1 ref EcuPartition that is mapped to a ProcessingUnit processingUnit HwElement 0..1 ref HwElement with category ProcessingUnit to which the EcuPartion is mapped. Table 5.52: EcuPartitionToCoreMapping [constr_9355] Category of HwElement for EcuPartitionToCoreMapping Imposition time: CP: IT_EcuExt ⌈The HwElement, which is referenced by EcuPartitionToCoreMapping in the role processingUnit, shall be of category "‘ProcessingUnit"’.⌋ [constr_9359] Different EcuPartitionToCoreMapping.coreId attribute values shall not be assigned to the same processingUnit Imposition time: CP: IT_EcuExt ⌈EcuPartitionToCoreMappings that reference the same HwElement in the role processingUnit shall not define different values for the EcuPartitionTo- CoreMapping.coreId attribute.⌋ If several EcuPartitionToCoreMappings reference the same HwElement in the role processingUnit it is allowed that only a subset of those EcuPartitionTo- CoreMappings defines the coreId value as long as [constr_9359] is fulfilled and different coreId values are not assigned to the same processingUnit.
